scope.full_memory_and_performance: Linux glibc x64; synthetic 20K/100K/200K/400K and Cohere Medium 1M; IVF/DiskANN; fixed parameters in the harness; 128/512/1024 MiB capacity matrix returns IDs/scores only, full field/vector lifecycle starts at 512 MiB
scope.desktop_lifecycle: Linux ARM64, macOS ARM64/x64, Windows x64/ARM64; 20K IVF/DiskANN plus the platform test suites
scope.compatibility_only: musl x64/ARM64; Android x86_64 emulator/ARM64 compile; iOS ARM64 simulator/device SDK compile
scope.excluded: Physical Android/iOS devices, hour-long and million-scale runs outside Linux x64, arbitrary host allocations and request sizes
scope.optional_physical_device: Manual Android ARM64 / iOS device pressure, denial and recovery; requires provisioned hardware and signing. Injected SDK host-pressure notifications, not OS memory-warning delivery.
